message: みんな見えたよね？

name: Synn
message: 「This was the centerpiece of the Holy Night Festival last year, wasn't it?」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah. The church isn't big enough to fit the entire student body.」
Our voices echo through the empty auditorium.
Club activities don't resume until tomorrow.

name: Misa
message: 「After all, since you were the one who planned it, Big Sister, it was a magnificent, deeply sacred event brimming with joy...\s04」

name: Ria
message: 「I-It wasn't that amazing\s01」

name: Nanaka
message: 「A communion service, a candlelight service, and a super fancy dance party. It felt just like a mission school--lots of first-time experiences for me.」

name: Ria
message: 「Nanaka-chan, it didn't just 'feel' like one, we literally are one.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「By candlelight service, you mean that exciting event where you swing around a giant lit crimson candle to light a row of other candles, right!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「No, it's nothing that fun--ahem, I mean, nothing that extreme.」

name: Misa
message: 「To begin with, getting a permit to use open flames indoors is a huge hassle. Even holding the candlelight service must have been tough, right?」

name: Ria
message: 「It wasn't that big of a deal. The candlelight service is a tradition, after all.」

name: Azel
message: 「Is this the only venue?」

name: Ria
message: 「For the main events, yeah.」

name: Azel
message: 「Filming will be easy--」

name: Synn
message: 「The open-entry events for regular students take place in the classrooms too, though.」

name: Ria
message: 「The Sweets Club is doing a maid cafe, right?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I'm gonna give it my all, yeah!」

name: Misa
message: 「I feel like that doesn't quite fit the atmosphere of the Holy Night Festival, which values tradition.」

name: Synn
message: 「Still, if we keep saying things like that, won't it feel too intimidating for regular students to join in?」

name: Ria
message: 「So that's why there were so few participants in the open-entry division.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Memorizing hymns and stuff is super hard, you know? Cool as they are.」

name: Misa
message: 「That's just the kind of event it is, so it can't be helped.」

name: Synn
message: 「...Ria-senpai」

name: Ria
message: 「What?」

name: Synn
message: 「If this was the main venue, that means you had to clean up every single time the event changed, right?」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah. The schedule was tight, so it was tough」

name: Synn
message: 「I've got it!」

name: Ria
message: 「Oh. Did you think of something?」

name: Synn
message: 「What do you think about splitting up the venues?」

name: Ria
message: 「We certainly wouldn't be pressed for time that way, but there aren't any suitable venues, you know?」

name: Synn
message: 「How about using classrooms for the open-participation events, and using the outdoors too?」

name: Misa
message: 「Being outside at the end of December is rough」

name: Synn
message: 「Not for all the events. For example, the dance party」

name: Ria
message: 「The dance party, huh...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「How about dancing in the plaza beneath Finis Tower?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It goes without saying, but it's wider than the auditorium!」

name: Synn
message: 「If we make this the venue, everyone will be able to dance even with the brass band included」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Found it!」

name: Paqy
message: 「What is it, soba? Did someone drop some money or something?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Light-up equipment! Wouldn't it be nice to dance under a lit-up Finis Tower?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Ria-chan's boob-- bouncing and jiggling around while she dances--」

name: Synn
message: 「Go to sleep for a bit」

name: Misa
message: 「Still, there's the fundamental problem of the cold」

name: Lolotte
message: 「We can just light a fire!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「That's pretty extreme」

name: Ria
message: 「Permission... Oh, right. It's easier to get permission for outdoors than for the auditorium」

name: Synn
message: 「That's it... a campfire!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Blazing away right in the middle of the plaza?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, yeah. Under the lit-up Finis Tower, everyone dances happily around a huge campfire to the brass band's music!」

name: Synn
message: 「Got any thoughts too, Azel?」

name: Azel
message: 「...You guys sure look like you're having fun for being on the job」

name: Synn
message: 「It's a sparkling academy life, so it wouldn't be right if we didn't have fun」

name: Lolotte
message: 「The Holy Night Festival will be fun too, you know」

name: Azel
message: 「Is that so...」

name: Ria
message: 「If we move a few events out of the auditorium, it'll free up time slots there, making it easier for clubs like the drama club and light music club to participate」

name: Misa
message: 「True, noisy clubs would probably rather perform in the auditorium than in a classroom」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Sounds like it's gonna get pretty hyped!」

name: Ria
message: 「Everyone. Are you prepared for this?」

name: Synn
message: 「Prepared...?」

name: Ria
message: 「Changing one major event will ripple out everywhere and fundamentally change the entire Holy Night Festival from last year, you know? Are you sure?」

name: Misa
message: 「Big Sister is right. Doing something new means taking on a fair amount of risk, after all」

name: Synn
message: 「True. We might fail. Still, you know」

name: Synn
message: 「Everyone saw it, right? The sight of the academy students dancing happily around a huge campfire beneath the lit-up Finis Tower」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I saw it!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Loud and clear」

name: Misa
message: 「If Sakura-kun could see it, there's no way I wouldn't!」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah... I saw it」

name: Synn
message: 「If there's even a chance that happy sight can become real, I think it's worth trying」

name: Misa
message: 「Don't say something so spineless like 'maybe.' We're going to make it happen」

name: Synn
message: 「Then, for this year's Holy Night Festival... does that mean we're going all out again with all sorts of things, just like KiraFes?」

name: Everyone
message: 「No objections!!」

name: Azel
message: 「You people will surely pull it off」

name: Synn
message: 「Azel. Let's do our best」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That's right. You're a member of the Student Council too, Azel-san」

name: Azel
message: 「Yeah... I suppose so」

name: Synn
message: 「Azel?」
I instinctively caught Azel's body.
So small. The breath exhaled was hot. Trembling faintly.

name: Azel
message: 「I'm fine... I can stand」

name: Synn
message: 「But」

name: Misa
message: 「Azel-san. You look pale」

name: Azel
message: 「It's nothing... I'm going home」
The strength used to brush my arm away was feeble.

name: Synn
message: 「We'll start the concrete planning the day after tomorrow, once exam break is over. Let's call it a day here」

name: Ria
message: 「Sounds good」

name: Synn
message: 「I'll walk you home」

name: Azel
message: 「No need!」
Once again, Azel tried to brush my arm away.
The strength behind it was chillingly weak, and I involuntarily let go.

name: Azel
message: 「...Sorry」
With a speed unimaginable from that frailty just moments ago, Azel bolted down from the plaza.

name: Ria
message: 「Synn-kun」

name: Synn
message: 「I know!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Me too...」
We chased after Azel.
Even though we ran all the way to the dorms, we couldn't catch up.
It was as if he had hidden himself somewhere.
